select.if: SELECT UNIT, UMREZ, UMREN FROM TB_MAS005 WHERE MATNR = #{MATNR}
SELECT BS_WGT, WLEN, VLEN FROM TB_MAS001 WHERE MATNR = #{MATNR}

mapper.select: SELECT WRK_METH AS VALUE_COL , FN_CD_VAL('WRKMETH',WRK_METH) || ' ' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(STR_TM, 'HH24:MI'), 'HH24:MI') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(END_TM, 'HH24:MI'), 'HH24:MI') AS TEXT_COL FROM TB_MAS027 WHERE 1=1 AND MACH_CD = TRIM(#{MACH_CD}) ORDER BY WRK_METH

SELECT
CASE WHEN #{PHYIKY} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(#{PHYIKY}) <> '' THEN #{KYH} ELSE (SELECT SZF_GETDOCNUMBER@KNRAWMSLINK(#{PHSCTY}) FROM DUAL) END AS PHYIKY , ' ' AS INDDCL , ' ' AS DOCTXT , ' ' AS BLIND , F_SET_DATE@KNRAWMSLINK(SYSDATE) AS DOCDAT , '500' AS DOCCAT, NVL((SELECT SHORTX FROM DOCCM@KNRAWMSLINK WHERE DOCCAT = '500' ), ' ') AS DOCCATNM , #{PHSCTY} AS DOCUTY, NVL((SELECT SHORTX FROM DOCTM@KNRAWMSLINK WHERE DOCUTY = #{PHSCTY}), ' ') AS DOCUTYNM , #{WAREKY} AS WAREKY, NVL((SELECT NAME01 FROM WAHMA WHERE WAREKY = #{WAREKY}), ' ') AS WARENM , #{PHSCTY} AS PHSCTY , #{PHYCOP} AS PHYCOP FROM DUAL

WITH INV001 AS (SELECT WERKS , STOR_LOC_CD , LOT_NO , MATNR , IND_BCD , UNIT , SUM(STCK_QTY) AS STCK_QTY , LOC_CD , MACH_CD , MACHINE , STCK_STA FROM TB_INV001 WHERE 1 = 1 AND WERKS = #{WERKS} AND SUBSTR(IND_BCD, 6, 1) != 'T' AND NVL(DLFL, 'N') in ('N', 'A') AND STCK_STA != '80' -- 2025.08.20 상태값 제거 (WMS입고 요청) ${RANGE_SQL} -- AND LOT_NO = V_LOT_NO -- AND MATNR = MATNR GROUP BY WERKS, STOR_LOC_CD, LOT_NO, MATNR, IND_BCD, UNIT, LOC_CD, MACH_CD, MACHINE, STCK_STA) , TB_STOCK AS (SELECT I001.WERKS , I001.STOR_LOC_CD , REPLACE(I001.LOT_NO, ' ', '') AS LOT_NO , I001.MATNR , I001.IND_BCD , I001.UNIT , (NVL(I001.STCK_QTY, 0) + SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN I001.UNIT = I003.UNIT THEN NVL(I003.STCK_QTY, 0) ELSE CASE WHEN I003.UNIT = 'EA' THEN I003.STCK_QTY / ((SUBSTR(I001.MATNR, 10, 4) / 1000) * (SUBSTR(I001.MATNR, 14, 4) / 1000) * (SUBSTR(I001.MATNR, 6, 3) / 1000)) WHEN I003.UNIT = 'R' THEN NVL(I003.STCK_QTY, 0) * 500 WHEN I003.UNIT = 'KG' AND SUBSTR(I003.LOT_NO, 5, 1) = 'P' THEN ROUND(I003.STCK_QTY / (I003.WGT / I003.PRE_IN_QTY), 3) ELSE 0 END END, 0)) ) AS STCK_QTY , LOC_CD , MACH_CD , MACHINE , STCK_STA FROM INV001 I001 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT WERKS , LOT_NO , IND_BCD , UNIT , SUM(STCK_QTY) AS STCK_QTY , SUM(WGT) AS WGT , SUM(PRE_IN_QTY) AS PRE_IN_QTY FROM TB_INV003 WHERE 1 = 1 AND WERKS = #{WERKS} AND STCK_QTY > 0 GROUP BY WERKS, LOT_NO, MATNR, IND_BCD, UNIT ) I003 ON I001.WERKS = I003.WERKS AND I001.LOT_NO = I003.LOT_NO AND I001.IND_BCD = I003.IND_BCD WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY I001.WERKS, I001.STOR_LOC_CD, I001.LOT_NO, I001.MATNR, I001.IND_BCD, I001.UNIT, I001.STCK_QTY, I001.LOC_CD, I001.MACH_CD, I001.MACHINE, I001.STCK_STA) SELECT * FROM TB_STOCK WHERE 1 = 1 AND NVL(STCK_QTY, 0) > 0 ${RANGE_SQL} ORDER BY STOR_LOC_CD, LOT_NO, IND_BCD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PHYDH ( PHYIKY, WAREKY, INDDCL , PHSCTY, DOCDAT, DOCCAT , TRNDAT, TRNTIM, TRNUSR , USRID1, UNAME1, DEPTID1, DNAME1 , USRID2, UNAME2, DEPTID2, DNAME2 , USRID3, UNAME3, DEPTID3, DNAME3 , USRID4, UNAME4, DEPTID4, DNAME4 , DOCTXT , CREDAT, CRETIM, CREUSR , LMODAT, LMOTIM, LMOUSR , INDBZL, INDARC, UPDCHK ) VALUES ( #{PHYIKY}, #{WAREKY}, NVL(#{INDDCL}, ' ') , #{PHSCTY}, #{DOCDAT}, #{DOCCAT} , NVL(#{TRNDAT}, ' '), NVL(#{TRNTIM}, ' '), NVL(#{TRNUSR}, ' ') , ' ', ' ', ' ' , ' ' , ' ', ' ', ' ' , ' ' , ' ', ' ', ' ' , ' ' , ' ', ' ', #{BLIND}, ' ' , #{DOCTXT} , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{SES_USER_ID} , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{SES_USER_ID} , ' ', ' ', 0 )

INSERT INTO PHYDI ( PHYIKY, PHYIIT, AREAKY, LOCAKY, TRNUID , QTADJU, QTSPHY, QTYPDA, QTSIWH, QTSALO , QTSPMO, QTSPMI, QTBLKD , QTSIQT, QTSHQT, QTSCNU, QTSWQT , UOMKEY , OWNRKY, SKUKEY, DESC01, DESC02 , LOTA01, LOTA02, LOTA03, LOTA04, LOTA05 , LOTA06, LOTA07, LOTA08, LOTA09, LOTA10 , LOTA11, LOTA12, LOTA13, LOTA14, LOTA15 , LOTA16, LOTA17, LOTA18, LOTA19, LOTA20 , ASKU01, ASKU02, ASKU03, ASKU04, ASKU05 , EANCOD, GTINCD , SKUG01, SKUG02, SKUG03, SKUG04, SKUG05 , GRSWGT, NETWGT, WGTUNT, LENGTH, WIDTHW , HEIGHT, CUBICM, CAPACT, RSNADJ, ADJRSN , CREDAT, CRETIM, CREUSR , LMODAT, LMOTIM, LMOUSR , INDBZL, INDARC, UPDCHK )
SELECT #{item.PHYIKY} AS PHYIKY , #{item.PHYIIT} AS PHYIIT , NVL(#{item.AREAKY}, ' ') AS AREAKY , NVL(#{item.LOC_CD}, ' ') AS LOCAKY , NVL(#{item.TRNUID}, ' ') AS TRNUID , 0 AS QTADJU , 0 AS QTSPHY , 0 AS QTYPDA , #{item.STCK_QTY} AS QTSIWH , 0 AS QTSALO , 0 AS QTSPMO , 0 AS QTSPMI , 0 AS QTBLKD , 0 AS QTSIQT , 0 AS QTSHQT , 0 AS QTSCNU , 0 AS QTSWQT , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY , SM.OWNRKY AS OWNRKY , SM.SKUKEY AS SKUKEY , ' ' AS DESC01, SM.DESC02 , NVL(#{item.STOR_LOC_CD}, ' ') AS LOTA01 , NVL(#{item.WERKS}, ' ') AS LOTA02 , ' ' AS LOTA03 , NVL(#{item.MACHINE}, ' ') AS LOTA04 , ' ' AS LOTA05 , NVL(#{item.STCK_STA}, ' ') AS LOTA06 , ' ' AS LOTA07 , ' ' AS LOTA08 , ' ' AS LOTA09 , ' ' AS LOTA10 , ' ' AS LOTA11 , ' ' AS LOTA12 , ' ' AS LOTA13 , NVL(#{item.IND_BCD}, ' ') AS LOTA14 , NVL(#{item.LOT_NO}, ' ') AS LOTA15 , 0 AS LOTA16 , ' ' AS LOTA17 , 0 AS LOTA18 , 0 AS LOTA19 , 0 AS LOTA20 , SM.ASKU01, SM.ASKU02, SM.ASKU03, SM.ASKU04, SM.ASKU05 , SM.EANCOD, SM.GTINCD , SM.SKUG01, SM.SKUG02, SM.SKUG03, SM.SKUG04, SM.SKUG05 , SM.GRSWGT, SM.NETWGT, SM.WGTUNT, SM.LENGTH, SM.WIDTHW , SM.HEIGHT, SM.CUBICM, SM.CAPACT, ' ' AS RSNADJ, ' ' AS ADJRSN , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{item.SES_USER_ID} , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{item.SES_USER_ID} , ' ', ' ', 0 FROM SKUMA@KNRAWMSLINK SM INNER JOIN SKUWC@KNRAWMSLINK SW ON SW.WAREKY = '1100' AND SW.OWNRKY = SM.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = SM.SKUKEY WHERE SM.OWNRKY = 'KN' AND SM.SKUKEY = #{item.MATNR}

SELECT PH.PHYIKY , PH.DOCDAT , PH.INDDCL , PH.DOCTXT , PH.DEPTID4 AS BLIND , PH.PHSCTY AS DOCUTY, SZF_GET_DOCUTY_TEXT@KNRAWMSLINK('KR', PH.PHSCTY) AS DOCUTYNM , PH.DOCCAT AS DOCCAT, SZF_GET_DOCCAT_TEXT@KNRAWMSLINK('KR', PH.DOCCAT) AS DOCCATNM , PH.WAREKY, (SELECT NAME01 FROM WAHMA WHERE WAREKY = PH.WAREKY) AS WARENM , PH.CREDAT, PH.CRETIM, PH.CREUSR, NVL((SELECT NMLAST FROM USRMA WHERE USERID = PH.CREUSR),' ') AS CUSRNM , PH.LMODAT, PH.LMOTIM, PH.LMOUSR, NVL((SELECT NMLAST FROM USRMA WHERE USERID = PH.LMOUSR),' ') AS LUSRNM , SUM(QTSIWH) - SUM(QTSPHY) AS ISDIFF FROM PHYDH PH INNER JOIN PHYDI PI ON PH.PHYIKY = PI.PHYIKY WHERE 1=1 AND PH.PHYIKY = #{PHYIKY} AND PH.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND PH.DOCDAT >= #{PHDTFR} AND #{PHDTTO} >= PH.DOCDAT AND PH.INDDCL = #{INDDCL} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SKUMA WHERE SKUKEY = PI.SKUKEY AND SKUL01 = #{SKUL01}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SKUMA WHERE SKUKEY = PI.SKUKEY AND SKUG01 = #{SKUG01}) AND UPPER(PI.DESC01) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{DESC01}) || '%'
${RANGE_SQL} GROUP BY PH.PHYIKY , PH.PHSCTY , PH.DOCDAT , PH.INDDCL , PH.DOCTXT , PH.DEPTID4 , PH.DOCCAT , PH.WAREKY , PH.CREDAT, PH.CRETIM, PH.CREUSR , PH.LMODAT, PH.LMOTIM, PH.LMOUSR ORDER BY 1 DESC

WITH WRK43 AS ( SELECT I009.WRK_ORDR_NO AS WRK_ORDR_NO , I009.WERKS AS WERKS , I009.STOR_LOC_CD AS STOR_LOC_CD , I009.LOC_CD AS LOC_CD , I009.MATNR AS MATNR , I009.LOT_NO AS LOT_NO , NVL(TRIM(I009.IND_BCD), '*') AS IND_BCD , I009.REAL_QTY AS REAL_INSP_QTY --, 'R' AS UOMKEY , CASE WHEN I001.UNIT = 'EA' THEN 'R' ELSE I001.UNIT END AS UOMKEY , I009.REGID AS REGID , TO_CHAR(I009.REGDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS CREDAT , TO_CHAR(I009.REGDATE, 'HH24MISS') AS CRETIM FROM TB_INV009 I009 INNER JOIN TB_INV001 I001 ON I009.WERKS = I001.WERKS AND I009.IND_BCD = I001.IND_BCD INNER JOIN TB_MAS003 M003 ON I009.WERKS = M003.WERKS AND I009.STOR_LOC_CD = M003.STOR_LOC_CD LEFT JOIN TB_MAS028 M028 ON I009.WERKS = M028.WERKS AND I009.STOR_LOC_CD = M028.STOR_LOC_CD AND I009.LOC_CD = M028.LOC_CD INNER JOIN TB_MAS001 M001 ON I009.WERKS = M001.WERKS AND I009.MATNR = M001.MATNR WHERE 1=1 AND I009.WRK_ORDR_NO = #{PHYIKY} AND SUBSTR(I009.IND_BCD, 6, 1) != 'T' -- 수제단 바코드 제외처리 --AND I001.STCK_STA != '80' -- 2025.08.20 상태값 제거 (WMS입고 요청) --AND I009.WERKS = 'P200' )
SELECT R1.* , DECODE(QTSIWH, REAL_INSP_QTY, 'N', 'Y') AS PI_GAP_YN , (SELECT SUM(PRE_IN_QTY) FROM TB_INV003 WHERE IND_BCD = R1.LOTA14) AS PRE_IN_QTY -- 투입 , (SELECT SUM(USE_QTY) FROM TB_INV010 WHERE IND_BCD_M = R1.LOTA14 AND SUBSTR(IND_BCD, 6, 1) != 'T' AND NVL(CNL_YN, 'N') != 'Y') AS USE_QTY -- 사용 , (SELECT SUM(DECODE(UNIT, 'R', DISPO_QTY, WGT)) FROM TB_WRK004 WHERE IND_BCD_M = R1.LOTA14 AND NVL(CNL_YN, 'N') = 'N') AS WASTE04_QTY -- 폐품(가공) , (SELECT SUM(DECODE(UNIT, 'R', DISPO_QTY, WGT)) FROM TB_WRK022 WHERE IND_BCD_M = R1.LOTA14 AND SUBSTR(IND_BCD, 6, 1) != 'T' AND NVL(CNL_YN, 'N') = 'N') AS WASTE22_QTY -- 폐품(영업, 잔량)
FROM (
SELECT NVL(PI.PHYIIT, 'NEW') PHYIIT, NVL(PI.LOTA02, WRK43.WERKS) LOTA02, NVL(PI.LOTA01, WRK43.STOR_LOC_CD) LOTA01, NVL(PI.LOCAKY, WRK43.LOC_CD) LOCAKY, NVL(PI.LOTA15, WRK43.LOT_NO) LOTA15, NVL(PI.LOTA14, WRK43.IND_BCD) LOTA14, NVL(PI.SKUKEY, WRK43.MATNR) SKUKEY, NVL(PI.DESC01, ' ') DESC01, CASE WHEN PI.UOMKEY = 'EA' THEN NVL(PI.QTSIWH, 0)/500 ELSE TO_NUMBER(PI.QTSIWH) END AS QTSIWH, WRK43.REAL_INSP_QTY, --(SELECT SUM(PRE_IN_QTY) FROM TB_INV003 WHERE IND_BCD = PI.LOTA14 AND WERKS = PI.LOTA02 AND GREATEST(REGDATE, UPDDATE) > TO_DATE(PI.CREDAT || PI.CRETIM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) AS PRE_IN_QTY, --(SELECT SUM(USE_QTY) FROM TB_INV010 WHERE IND_BCD_M = WRK43.IND_BCD AND WERKS = WRK43.WERKS) AS USE_QTY, CASE WHEN PI.UOMKEY = 'EA' THEN 'R' ELSE NVL(PI.UOMKEY, WRK43.UOMKEY) END AS UOMKEY, PI.QTSIWH * TRUNC(NVL(DECODE(MV.PEINH, 0, 0, MV.STPRS / MV.PEINH), 0)) AS STKAMT, PI.LOTA06, PI.LOTA04, NVL(PI.CREDAT, WRK43.CREDAT) CREDAT, NVL(PI.CRETIM, WRK43.CRETIM) CRETIM, NVL(PI.CREUSR, WRK43.REGID) CREUSR, PI.LMODAT, PI.LMOTIM, PI.LMOUSR FROM PHYDI PI INNER JOIN SKUMA@KNRAWMSLINK SM ON PI.OWNRKY= SM.OWNRKY AND PI.SKUKEY = SM.SKUKEY LEFT JOIN MATVAL@KNRAWMSLINK MV ON MV.MATNR = PI.SKUKEY AND MV.BWKEY = PI.LOTA02 AND MV.MEINS = PI.UOMKEY FULL OUTER JOIN WRK43 ON PI.LOTA14 = WRK43.IND_BCD AND WRK43.WRK_ORDR_NO = PI.PHYIKY WHERE NVL(PI.PHYIKY, WRK43.WRK_ORDR_NO) = #{PHYIKY} ) R1

SELECT T1.PRFM_DT, T1.USE_QTY, T2.USE_QTY AS CLOSE, T1.USE_QTY - T2.USE_QTY AS USE_DIFF FROM (SELECT WERKS, PRFM_DT, SUM(USE_QTY) AS USE_QTY FROM TB_INV010 WHERE WERKS = #{WERKS} AND PRFM_DT BETWEEN #{SDATE} AND #{EDATE} AND NVL(CNL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND USE_DIV IN ('1', '2') GROUP BY WERKS, PRFM_DT) T1 FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT WERKS, PRFM_DT, SUM(USE_QTY) AS USE_QTY FROM TB_INV013 WHERE WERKS = #{WERKS} AND PRFM_DT BETWEEN #{SDATE} AND #{EDATE} AND NVL(SDOC_NO, ' ') != ' ' GROUP BY WERKS, PRFM_DT) T2 ON T1.WERKS = T2.WERKS AND T1.PRFM_DT = T2.PRFM_DT ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT NVL(T1.WERKS, T2.WERKS) AS WERKS , NVL(T1.MACH_CD, T2.MACH_CD) AS MACH_CD , NVL(T1.ORDER_NO, T2.ORDER_NO) AS ORDER_NO , NVL(T1.MATNR_M, T2.MATNR) AS MATNR , (SELECT MATNR_NM FROM TB_MAS001 WHERE WERKS = NVL(T1.WERKS, T2.WERKS) AND MATNR = NVL(T1.MATNR_M, T2.MATNR)) AS MATNR_NM , NVL(T1.LOT_NO_M, T2.LOT_NO) AS LOT_NO , NVL(T1.USE_QTY, 0) AS USE_QTY , NVL(T2.USE_QTY, 0) AS CLOSE , NVL(T1.USE_QTY, 0) - NVL(T2.USE_QTY, 0) AS USE_DIFF FROM (SELECT WERKS , MACH_CD , MATNR_M , LOT_NO_M , WRK_ORDR_NO , WRK_ORDR_SEQNO , (SELECT ORDER_NO FROM TB_WRK001 WHERE PRFM_DT = TB_INV010.PRFM_DT AND WRK_ORDR_NO = TB_INV010.WRK_ORDR_NO AND WRK_ORDR_SEQNO = TB_INV010.WRK_ORDR_SEQNO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS ORDER_NO , PRFM_DT , SUM(USE_QTY) AS USE_QTY FROM TB_INV010 WHERE WERKS = #{WERKS} AND PRFM_DT = #{SDATE} AND NVL(CNL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND USE_DIV IN ('1', '2') GROUP BY WERKS, MACH_CD, MATNR_M, LOT_NO_M, WRK_ORDR_NO, WRK_ORDR_SEQNO, PRFM_DT) T1 FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT WERKS, MACH_CD, ORDER_NO, MATNR, LOT_NO, USE_QTY FROM TB_INV013 WHERE WERKS = #{WERKS} AND PRFM_DT = #{SDATE} AND NVL(SDOC_NO, ' ') <> ' ') T2 ON T1.WERKS = T2.WERKS AND T1.MACH_CD = T2.MACH_CD AND T1.MATNR_M = T2.MATNR AND T1.LOT_NO_M = T2.LOT_NO AND T1.ORDER_NO = T2.ORDER_NO

SELECT INV001.RCV_DT AS RCVCDS_DT, INV001.STOR_LOC_CD, INV001.MATNR, MAS001.MATNR_NM, INV001.LOT_NO, INV001.IND_BCD, INV001.RCV_WGT AS RCVGDS_QTY, INV001.STCK_STA, CDV.CDESC1, INV001.STCK_QTY FROM TB_INV001 INV001 INNER JOIN TB_MAS001 MAS001 ON INV001.WERKS = MAS001.WERKS AND INV001.MATNR = MAS001.MATNR INNER JOIN CMCDV CDV ON INV001.STCK_STA = CDV.CMCDVL AND CDV.CMCDKY = 'STCK_STA' WHERE INV001.WERKS = #{WERKS} AND INV001.MATNR LIKE 'H0000%' AND INV001.RCV_DT BETWEEN #{SDATE} AND #{EDATE} ORDER BY INV001.RCV_DT, INV001.LOT_NO, INV001.IND_BCD
